boundary: The paid-check total is a source-backed floor, not a complete disbursement total if non-check payment modes are absent from Bank Checks.
The gross ceiling-to-check difference is not an unpaid residual because ordinance ceilings, funding origins, periods, reversals, and contract scopes require ordinance-level reconciliation.
Project vendors mentioning Smart Columbus were excluded from the direct-recipient total.
method: Unique paid City Auditor bank-check records filtered to exact direct vendor accounts or exact direct payees.
